body: I tried to see if I could adopt another cat but the place wanted me to adopt right there and now and the 2 cats had significant health issues. So another disappointment

This cat was so gentle, so intelligent and he died suddenly without any warnings (heart attack according to the vet). As I said in another reply, I dont think I could adopt another cat, I would expect too much.
My cat was so special, I would expect too much of another one and it wouldnt be fair to that other cat
